description: A single-panel, two-column table (no sub-figures, no axes or scale bars) titled by its caption as "Table 4 Material properties of Fe-30Mn-9Al-0.8 C low-density steel". The left column header reads "Material Properties" and the right column header reads "Values"; a horizontal rule separates the header row from thirteen data rows. The rows, transcribed exactly as printed, are: Density (gm/cm3) = 6.8; Young's modulus (MPa) = 160,000; Poisson's ratio = 0.3; sigma_0 (MPa) = 380; B (MPa) = 1860; Dislocation strengthening constant k1 (m-2), k2 = 7.9E+15, 1.8; Grain size strengthening constant = 2374,; k (MPa um0.5), k3 = 0.63; n = 1.02; m = 0.87; C = 0.0067; Melting temperature (°C) = 1450; Reference temperature (°C) = 27. The grain-size-strengthening entry is split across two label rows (the constant 2374 on one line and the symbol pair "k (MPa um0.5), k3" with value 0.63 on the next), so the table's row alignment is ambiguous at that point. The table collects the elastic constants, Johnson-Cook-type constitutive parameters and thermal reference data used as input for the ABAQUS VUMAT simulation of multiaxial forging of this low-density steel; it contains no graphical data and no trends.

subfigures.description: Two-column table with headers 'Material Properties' and 'Values', listing density, Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, sigma_0, B, dislocation strengthening constants k1 and k2, grain size strengthening constants, k, k3, n, m, C, melting temperature and reference temperature for Fe-30Mn-9Al-0.8 C low-density steel. No images, plots, axes or scale bars are present.

observations.observation: The figure is a table with only two columns, headed 'Material Properties' and 'Values', containing 13 data rows.
Density is listed as 6.8 gm/cm3 and Young's modulus as 160,000 MPa.
The flow-stress parameters are sigma_0 = 380 MPa and B = 1860 MPa.
The dislocation strengthening constants are listed on one row as k1 (m-2) = 7.9E+15 and k2 = 1.8.

Grain size strengthening constants are printed as 2374 on the row labelled 'Grain size strengthening constant' and as k (MPa um0.5), k3 = 0.63 on the following row, so the label-value pairing across these two lines is ambiguous in the rendering.
Exponent/coefficient entries are n = 1.02, m = 0.87 and C = 0.0067.
Thermal reference values are melting temperature 1450 °C and reference temperature 27 °C.
The caption states that the listed values are the material properties of Fe-30Mn-9Al-0.8 C low-density steel.
The citing text states that these material properties are used with the modified Johnson-Cook constitutive equation (Eq. 6) implemented through a VUMAT subroutine in ABAQUS.
The citing text states that the original Johnson-Cook model parameters of this material had been evaluated in the authors' previous study [26].
The citing text states that texture effects are not considered in the simulation, and attributes the lower simulated strength relative to experimentally measured values to this omission.

unreadable_items: The label-to-value pairing for the 'Grain size strengthening constant' row and the following 'k (MPa um0.5), k3' row is ambiguous because the value 2374 is printed with a trailing comma and the symbol definitions appear on the next line; it is not possible to decide from the rendering alone whether 2374 belongs to the grain size strengthening constant and 0.63 to k and k3, or vice versa.
